summary.text: Wyatt Beaulieu is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat William Bridgeo.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and was a candidate for the Augusta City Council in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Beaulieu ran for an at-large seat on the Augusta City Council in the nonpartisan election on November 4, 2025, and finished third in a race for two seats with 1,995 votes.
He won the Republican primary for Maine House District 60 on June 9, 2026, with 624 votes.
